canonical.title: A weekend in Lausanne, anchored on a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Lausanne
siblings.summary: Two-day Lausanne itinerary: Olympic Museum, Plateforme 10, a Lavaux vineyard walk, a CGN paddle steamer, and where to eat between Michelin courses.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Lausanne
siblings.summary: Three top-tier tables anchor a Lausanne weekend: Crissier's 3-star Hôtel de Ville, Pic at Beau-Rivage Palace, and La Table at Lausanne Palace.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Lausanne
siblings.summary: Lausanne's tech-conference calendar is front-loaded: AMLD in Feb, Insomni'hack in March, HackSummit in April do the heavy lifting.

sources.title: Lausanne Station → Crissier (Rome2Rio)
sources.claim: Crissier reachable in ~7 minutes by SBB from Lausanne main station.

sources.title: Lausanne M2 metro (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: M2 between Ouchy and Flon, 11.6% gradient — among the steepest metros in the world.

sources.title: Pic at Beau-Rivage Palace (official)
sources.claim: Anne-Sophie Pic's 2-star at Beau-Rivage Palace; Sunday lunch added from 19 April 2026.

sources.title: Restaurant de l'Hôtel de Ville Crissier (official)
sources.claim: Lunch 12–13:00, dinner 19:00–20:30, Tue–Sat.

sources.title: La Table du Lausanne Palace (official)
sources.claim: Dinner Wed–Sat 19:00–23:00 (last order 20:00); chef Franck Pelux.

sources.title: Lavaux Route 113 vineyard hike
sources.claim: St-Saphorin → Lutry: 11.6 km, ~4 h, 200 m up / 500 m down.

sources.title: Lausanne → Cully (Rome2Rio)
sources.claim: Lausanne ↔ Cully SBB train ~8–10 minutes, every ~15 minutes.

sources.title: SS La Suisse (CGN)
sources.claim: 1910 Belle Époque paddle steamer; ~3-hour Lavaux/Chillon loop from Lausanne-Ouchy.

sources.title: Lausanne Transport Card (official)
sources.claim: Free transit card given at hotel check-in, valid the whole stay.

sources.title: Lausanne walkability guide
sources.claim: Three steep hills in town — neutralised by M2 and funiculars.

sources.title: EPFL campus events
sources.claim: Only a niche Artificial Life workshop at Centre Bernoulli on the May 29–31 weekend.

sources.title: AMLD 2026
sources.claim: Applied Machine Learning Days, Feb 10–12 at EPFL.

sources.title: Insomni'hack 2026
sources.claim: Insomni'hack security conference, Mar 16–20.

sources.title: HackSummit 2026
sources.claim: HackSummit, Apr 22–23.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Lausanne (Tourism office)
sources.claim: Crissier holds three Michelin stars retained for the past 30 years.

sources.title: Lausanne's exceptional tables
sources.claim: One 3-star (Crissier), two 2-star tables (Pic, La Table) in/around Lausanne.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — all-starred Lausanne
sources.claim: Official Michelin index for Lausanne's starred restaurants.

sources.title: Plateforme 10 tickets (official)
sources.claim: Three museums 10:00–18:00; combined ticket CHF 25 / 19 reduced, single CHF 15.

sources.title: Lausanne Cathedral (official)
sources.claim: Open daily 09:00–19:00 Apr–Sep; belfry CHF 6 adult, free under 25.

sources.title: Olympic Museum (official)
sources.claim: Tue–Sun 09:00–18:00, closed Mondays; CHF 20 full / CHF 14 reduced.

sources.title: Ouchy lakefront promenade (official)
sources.claim: Tree-lined quays since 1901; promenade Saint-Sulpice ↔ Lutry; 130+ rose species at Place du Général Guisan.

sources.title: Lavaux Vinorama (official)
sources.claim: ~300 wines from the eight Lavaux appellations; 8-language documentary.

sources.title: Lavaux Express tourist train
sources.claim: Two 1h15 loops at CHF 17 from April 1 to November 1.

sources.title: Sauvabelin Tower (official)
sources.claim: 35 m wooden tower with double-helix staircase; 302 steps; free entry, 30-person cap.

sources.title: CGN cruises from Lausanne-Ouchy
sources.claim: Lausanne-Ouchy → Lutry 18 min, Cully 33 min, Rivaz/St-Saphorin 47 min.
